description: This file defines a Lua function 'Head' that generates HTML head elements based on properties. It constructs meta tags, links, scripts, and other head components for a webpage, including support for different page purposes such as homepage, reference, symbol, module, and editor.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: Generates the <head> section of an HTML document based on provided properties such as page name, metadata, media assets, and purpose.
